newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Two Malaysia air force helicopters reported missing.
newsitem.headline: Two Malaysia air force helicopters reported missing.

text.p: Two Malaysian Air Force helicopters went missing after a mission in the eastern Sabah state, the Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF) said on Wednesday.

The two Nuri helicopters were scheduled to arrive at their base on Labuan island off Borneo at 4.55 p.m. (0900 GMT) on Tuesday, an RMAF statement said, adding that the last radio contact with the aircraft was at 4.21 p.m.
It said a search operation launched late on Tuesday was continuing.
The statement did not give the number of people on board the two helicopters.
